Gut-check / judgment moves on that order: (a) World Series 8 -> 3: gut #2; Gallup 2001 #2, Harris 2012 #2, Deadspin 2025 #3, Repucom #4, TV #9 (15.5M series avg, Game 7 ~26M, #5 US telecast of 2025); its average is dragged only because YouGov Ratings does not track it at all (penalty 26). Without that untracked penalty it averages ~5.4. (b) Winter Olympics 2 -> 8: its #2 comes from Numerator, a 3-event poll fielded two weeks before Milan Cortina, and from YouGov's generic 'Olympics' entry credited to both Games; a typical adult names 'the Olympics' once (alias on Summer Olympics), so Winter is a second-tier answer; still top 10 (23.5M viewers, Repucom #3). (c) College Football Playoff 4 -> 6 and World Cup 7 -> 7, March Madness 5 -> 4, NBA Finals 6 -> 5: small reshuffle to make room for World Series; CFP is not in the gut 12 but has 5 sources (30.1M title game), so it stays top 6. (d) Daytona 500 15 -> 12: gut #10, Repucom #7 can't-miss, 7.5M viewers; no source puts it below 14. (e) Stanley Cup Final 22 -> 15: gut #9 as one of the four major-league finals; Gallup lists it (6th of 6, 7%) and TV is weak (2.55M, 22nd), so it is only lifted to the middle, not to its gut slot; YouGov does not track it. (f) US Open tennis 12 -> 13, Wimbledon 16 -> 14, Rose Bowl 14 -> 16, Women's World Cup 13 -> 17, MLB All-Star 17 -> 19, Open Championship 19 -> 20, Army-Navy 20 -> 21, Ryder Cup 21 -> 22: one-to-four-spot shifts to absorb the moves above (Women's World Cup drops because its last final drew 2.2M US viewers without the USWNT). confidence: High for 1-9 (Super Bowl, Olympics, World Series, March Madness, NBA Finals, CFP, World Cup, Winter Olympics, Kentucky Derby: each has 4-8 people sources). Medium for 10-16. Low-medium for 17-24, which mostly rest on two sources (YouGov Ratings + US TV audience) and are close together (averages 11.6-13.1), so their exact order is soft. Caveats: no source asks adults to name events unprompted; the polls are partial (several publish only top 3-10) and three are old (2001, 2012, 2015); YouGov Ratings does not track World Series, Stanley Cup, Daytona 500, NFL Draft, Rose Bowl, Army-Navy or the All-Star events, which biases the raw average against them; Google search interest could not be fetched. The World Series move to #3 and the Winter Olympics drop to #8 are judgment calls supported by the polls but not by the raw average.
